summary: First test run for BoostBac. Backend (17/17 tests, 100%): auth (register/login/me/duplicate-email/wrong-password), profile update+persistence, AI deck generation via Gemini vision (real study-notes JPEG, 5-12 cards returned in <30s), deck save→list, /home summary, /review/queue + /review/submit SM-2 correctness (ease_factor, interval, repetitions, next_review_date; XP increments 2/5/8/10 for again/hard/good/easy; streak touched), /review/complete bonus XP, /analytics (heatmap sorted by weakness + 14-day forgetting_curve + focus_subjects), /exams/generate (weighted) + /exams/submit (score+breakdown) + /exams/history. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): welcome (Arabic RTL default, FR/AR toggle), signup/login, Home (streak=1, XP=68 after test reviews, due-count updates, decks list, floating Scan CTA), Review (Arabic card rendered, flip available), Dashboard (heatmap + forgetting curve rendered), Exams tab (start-exam), Profile (stream/goal/language chips + logout-button visible). Scan screen shows expected 'camera permission required' fallback on web preview. Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: cards_reviewed_today counts by string-prefix on reviewed_at ISO datetimes ($gte 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Works because ISO ordering aligns, but a purpose-built index on reviewed date would be cleaner.
review_logs.reviewed_at is stored as ISO string; day-bucketing uses str.startswith which is correct but not timezone-aware for users outside UTC.

Stores image_base64[:200000] on the transient (unsaved) deck preview — fine, but SaveDeckInput.deck dict does not strip it, so a large base64 image can be persisted in decks collection if the client echoes back what /decks/generate returned. Consider trimming in /decks/save.
Loads all cards per deck in a Python loop (N+1). Fine for small volumes; a single aggregation would scale better.

issues: Deck row long titles get truncated with ellipsis in RTL (Arabic) — acceptable but subject count line renders LTR '10 · Physics' which reads oddly in Arabic layout.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin (use transformOrigin)'. These come from RN Web rendering of the graphics/ProgressRing SVG and glow() helper. Non-blocking on native but should be cleaned up. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (glow) and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:198 pointerEvents='box-none'.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Move `pointerEvents='box-none'` from prop to style prop in `/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx` fabWrap to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL: Replace `shadow*` StyleSheet keys with `boxShadow` (or wrap in Platform.select) in theme.ts / glow helper to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: In SVG-based ProgressRing / PaperPlane, ensure `transformOrigin` (camelCase) is used, not the CSS-style `transform-origin`.
OPTIONAL: Add `testID` to each `<Tabs.Screen>` (via `tabBarButtonTestID` or custom tabBarButton) so future E2E can target bottom tabs directly.
OPTIONAL: In POST /api/decks/save, drop `image_base64` from the incoming deck dict before persisting to keep the decks collection small.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 762-line file. It still fits, but is approaching the 700-line threshold — splitting into routers (auth, decks, review, analytics, exams) will help maintainability.

SM-2 implementation and XP/streak logic look correct: quality<3 resets reps and short-cycles; ease clamped to 1.3; streak resets when gap>1 day; longest_streak tracked. Verified end-to-end via API tests.
MongoDB ObjectId (`_id`) is consistently excluded via projections on every read — good.
All env vars sourced from environment (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). No hardcoded URLs.
Google OAuth flow correctly consumes ?session_id= on web callback and via Linking on native.

review_submit does not gate the streak update to correct answers only — even an 'again' rating still counts as activity for streak. This matches Duolingo-style behavior; flagging in case product wants otherwise.
seed_data_creation: Used shared test account test@boostbac.dz. Two Physics decks were created via /decks/generate + /decks/save (Newton's laws study notes JPEG); one was deleted at end of the API suite, the other remains and provided the 16-17 due cards seen on the Home screen during UI validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and runs with the repo pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope). It self-provisions the shared test account and self-generates a deck per worker via the `ensure_cards` fixture (Gemini call ~10-25s each). AI generation uses gemini-3-flash-preview via emergentintegrations LlmChat and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. The scan screen cannot be exercised on web preview (camera permission gate) — validate via API. Bottom tab bar has no testIDs; navigate by URL (/(tabs)/dashboard etc.) or add testIDs before UI E2E.
